title: Individual voucher and ambient-air estimates
question: Which adjusted-income deductions, assets, payment standards and personal exposure modifiers should replace the current gross-income voucher and area-mean PM2.5 estimates?
whyItMatters: The voucher uses recorded household wages, HUD FMR and the HUD very-low-income limit. Missing income uses the world's median recorded household pay, or the HUD eligibility ceiling when no pay is recorded. Personal ambient PM2.5 uses the existing outcome-web area value, with the median recorded area when local measurements are absent. These are labeled estimates and do not create diagnoses.

sourcesChecked.source: HUD Housing Choice Voucher Guidebook; 24 CFR 982.505 and 5.628
sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: The game does not yet record all household assets, deductions and local payment-standard choices.

sourcesChecked.source: EPA population-weighted PM2.5; Henneman et al. 2023, Science 382; EPA 2024 Carbon Pollution Standards RIA
sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: Area concentration does not establish individual dose or every territory's measured baseline.

usableAnswer: Supported fields and source-backed transformations for recorded households and residents in all 56 places.
